findings.function: every onlyAuthorized function (grantRole, revokeRole, renounceRole, setRoleAdmin, setRoleGuardian, setGrantDelay, setTargetFunctionRole, setTargetAdminDelay, setTargetClosed, updateAuthority, labelRole, ...)
findings.lines: e.g. 1578-1767 (setTargetFunctionRole: the selector loop printed at 1591, 1712 and 1761); 42 lines with 0x8d6122d000...
findings.source: AccessManager.sol: onlyAuthorized -> _checkAuthorized -> _canCallSelf / _getAdminRestrictions (compares the selector with this.setTargetFunctionRole.selector, etc.); setTargetFunctionRole: for (uint256 i = 0; i < selectors.length; ++i) _setTargetFunctionRole(...)
findings.issue: The selector 0x08d6122d prints with 63 digits (P6) in the admin-restriction tests of every function, reading as 0x8d6122d0; and the authorization outcome paths (immediate, delayed with schedule consumption) each get their own copy of the function body, so setTargetFunctionRole prints its selector loop three times.
findings.rule: Print a 4-byte value shifted to the top of the word as 'sel << 224' or with all 64 digits (P6); share the continuation after the authorization check between its paths (see c00463).

notes: Reviewed against OZ 5 AccessManager.sol (with Multicall, Time, Math). All 32 ABI functions were read by structure; each inlines onlyAuthorized (_checkAuthorized, canCall/_canCallSelf, _getAdminRestrictions, _consumeScheduledOp) before its own body (170-270 lines each). execute (schedule/consume, executionId bookkeeping, the target call with value), schedule, cancel, consumeScheduledOp, hashOperation and the getters were checked. Loops: 2 source loops (multicall's delegatecall loop and setTargetFunctionRole's selector loop, the latter printed three times) shown as while; implicit: the bytes[] result allocation (P3, 'while idx - 1') and its encode (P7). The text has no aborted path and only 1 P2 line. No execution run.
summary: Faithful and readable apart from the onlyAuthorized prologue repeated in every function, per-path copies of function bodies, and the setTargetFunctionRole selector printed with 63 digits in 42 lines.
